info.name: WorkPlus API
info.description: End-to-end checks for the WorkPlus performance tracker API (docs/api/README.md). Run in order (Collection Runner or `npx newman run`). Each run creates its own accounts (pm-*-<runId>@test.dev, employee codes PM-<runId>-n) and deactivates them in Cleanup; the seeded demo accounts are only signed in to, never changed. POST /auth/register is used twice per run (rate limit: 10 an hour per IP).
